basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own a beautifully preserved and thoughtfully updated Victorian home in the heart of Hayes Valley. This spacious residence features 4 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms perfectly blending classic architectural charm with modern updates. Graceful period details, high ceilings, and abundant natural light enhance the interior. The large formal living and dining room provides ideal space for entertaining. The remodeled kitchen includes updated appliances, ample counter space, a pantry closet and custom cabinetry with a functional layout. All bathrooms have been tastefully renovated with timeless finishes. Recent upgrades include fresh interior paint, refinished hardwood floors, and new light fixtures throughout. The 1-car garage offers parking and plenty of extra storage. Located just steps from premier Hayes Valley shops, restaurants, parks, and public transit. This home offers the perfect combination of historic San Francisco charm and modern city living.
